name: ZCH_BATCH_DATA_ENRICH_REQ
description: Table that stores the requirements of the enrichment process

columns.name: BATCH_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Primary Key, uniquely identifies a batch enrichment job

columns.name: BATCH_REQUEST_NAME
columns.description: User Entered Batch  Request Name

columns.name: SELECT_CRITERIA_ID
columns.description: Selection Criteria Id that would be used for applying filter

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Should be a lookup to different statuses that we have

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: The object type which is being enriched, could be organizations or persons

columns.name: BATCH_TYPE
columns.description: Type of Batch, which is being enriched, e.g. existing records, synchronization, etc.

columns.name: BATCH_MODE
columns.description: Column indicating if the mode is enrichment or preview

columns.name: MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Match Threshold score for matching

columns.name: NUM_RECORDS_PROCESSED
columns.description: Number of Records Processed in the batch

columns.name: NUM_RECORDS_MATCHED
columns.description: Number of Records for which DaaS found a match

columns.name: NUM_RECORDS_NO_MATCH
columns.description: Number of Records for which DaaS did a match

columns.name: NUM_RECORDS_REJECTED
columns.description: Number of Records Rejected by DaaS

columns.name: NUM_RECORDS_COMPLETED
columns.description: Number of Records Successfully Imported

columns.name: NUM_RECORDS_ERRORED
columns.description: Number of Records Errored  in the batch

columns.name: DAAS_OTPT_UCM_DOC_ID
columns.description: UCM Doc ID of file to be downloaded for DaaS o/p file

columns.name: DAAS_LOG_UCM_DOC_ID
columns.description: UCM Doc ID of Log file to be downloaded for DaaS o/p logs.

columns.name: INTERMEDIATE_STATUS
columns.description: Intermediate status for tracking.

columns.name: IMPORT_JOB_ID
columns.description:
Import Job ID to identify Import Job submitted
Foreign key to IMPORT_JOB_ID in MKT_IMP_JOBS

columns.name: BATCH_START_TIME
columns.description: When the batch processing was  started

columns.name: BATCH_END_TIME
columns.description: When the batch processing ended

columns.name: ERROR_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column is used to persist Error Code  for Failed Jobs

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
